topic: Talking about weather, seasons, and months
topicVi: Nói về thời tiết, các mùa và tháng
objectives: Can describe the weather using common adjectives
Can name the four seasons and twelve months
Can ask and answer about weather and seasons
objectivesVi: Có thể mô tả thời tiết bằng các tính từ phổ biến
Có thể gọi tên 4 mùa và 12 tháng
Có thể dùng 'It's' + tính từ để nói về thời tiết
Có thể hỏi và trả lời về thời tiết và mùa

vocab.def: with many clouds in the sky
the season between winter and summer
the season between summer and winter

grammar.explanation: Dùng 'It's' + tính từ để mô tả thời tiết. It's sunny/rainy/cloudy/windy/cold/hot/warm/cool. Hỏi: 'What's the weather like?' hoặc 'How's the weather?'
grammar.explanationVi: Dùng 'It's' + tính từ để mô tả thời tiết. It's sunny/rainy/cloudy/windy/cold/hot/warm/cool. Hỏi: 'What's the weather like?' hoặc 'How's the weather?'
commonMistakes: Sai: 'The weather is sunny.' (đúng nhưng ít dùng) → Phổ biến: 'It's sunny.'
Sai: 'It is rain.' → Đúng: 'It's rainy.' hoặc 'It's raining.'
Sai: 'What weather is it?' → Đúng: 'What's the weather like?'

grammar.sub: Naming months and connecting to seasons
grammar.explanation: 12 tháng: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December. Mùa xuân: March-May. Mùa hè: June-August. Mùa thu: September-November. Mùa đông: December-February.
grammar.explanationVi: 12 tháng: January, February, March, April, May, June, July, August, September, October, November, December. Mùa xuân: March-May. Mùa hè: June-August. Mùa thu: September-November. Mùa đông: December-February.
commonMistakes: Sai: 'I was born in January month.' → Đúng: 'I was born in January.'
Sai: 'In summer, it's hot.' (đúng) vs 'In the summer, it's hot.' (cũng đúng)
Sai: 'January is winter.' → Đúng: 'January is in winter.'

grammarChoose.vi: Hôm nay nhiều mây và gió.

reading.title: Four Seasons in Vietnam
reading.text: Vietnam has four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Spring is from February to April. It is warm and rainy. Summer is from May to August. It is very hot and sunny. Autumn is from September to November. It is cool and dry. Winter is from December to January. It is cold, especially in the north. In the south, winter is not very cold. Many people like autumn because the weather is nice. In summer, people go to the beach. In winter, people wear warm clothes.

questions.q: How many seasons does Vietnam have?

writing.prompt: Write 4 sentences about the weather in your city.
writing.promptVi: Viết 4 câu về thời tiết ở thành phố của bạn.
writing.template: In summer, it's ___. In winter, it's ___. My favorite season is ___ because ___. The weather today is ___.
checklist: Did you mention at least 2 seasons?

review.summary: In this unit, you learned to describe weather and talk about seasons and months. Key phrases: 'What's the weather like?', 'It's sunny/rainy/cloudy/windy/cold/hot/warm/cool.', 'What's your favorite season?', 'When is your birthday?'
review.summaryVi: Trong unit này, bạn đã học cách mô tả thời tiết và nói về mùa và tháng. Cụm từ quan trọng: 'What's the weather like?', 'It's sunny/rainy/cloudy/windy/cold/hot/warm/cool.', 'What's your favorite season?', 'When is your birthday?'
